column1: # manifests/singularity-payload.tsv -- reviewed PREBUILT Singularity Desktop
# payload .deb pins.  One row per arch:
#   <arch>\t<sha256>\t<version>
# The sha256 (field 2) is read by build/gen-base-pin.sh and emitted as
# singularity_payload_sha256_<arch> in manifests/determinism.pin; it seeds the
# "hotfix" layer fingerprint (build/lib/layerplan.py).  The image layers stage
# consumes exactly these bytes via NCZ_SINGULARITY_PREBUILT_DEB /
# NCZ_SINGULARITY_PREBUILT_SHA256 (build/layers-preflight.sh check_frozen_deb).
# The .deb version is a timestamped `YYYYMMDDhhmmss+bk0+tgz<hash>` string, so it
# cannot be statically pinned in manifests/ncz-packages.tsv (see the header of
# manifests/ncz-timestamped.tsv); the reviewed-ledger row for the timestamped
# form lives there, and this file records the concrete 26.10 build.
# Published to the NCZ apt repo: Buildkite Packages (primary) + R2 (backup).
# The 26.10 payload carries the singularity-shell queue 0015-0020
# (lock-over-saver overlay, no-prompt-before-input, freeze/HOLD on input,
# login-card parity, a second lock instance yields instead of taking the
# renderer socket, frame source backoff kept across handshakes and no source
# without an output) and the greeter/loginui parity patches (greeter 0003,
# loginui 0003).
# 20261013150000 is built from the 2026-10-13 upstream heads (superproject
# 6d6bbc7f: Messages, SIT, liquid glass) with the same patch queue; the arm64
# deb Depends on libgtk4-layer-shell0 (>= 1.3.0-1+ncz20261013)
# (build/singularity-depends-floors.tsv).
# 20261013233000 is built from the same upstream commits with the full queue:
# shell 0021 (overview clear of the dock), 0022 (logind Lock and
# PrepareForSleep), 0023 (saver resumes when the prompt lowers), leafs 0001
# (window buttons with the classic titlebar) and nearby 0001+0002 (links are
# freed when they close; an open link is kept when the peer announces itself).
# 2026-11-06: the arm64 row is a LOCAL build from superproject 6427e9c with the
# full downstream queue applied (shell 13, loginui 3, greeter 3, nearby 1,
# plugins 3, desktop 0) - version 20261106140923+bk0+git6427e9c4, built on a build host
# by build/build-singularity.sh + build-singularity-deb.sh (PAYLOAD_RC=0,
# 10235/10235 targets, 0 failures).
# 2026-11-06 (arm64, cycle 454): rebuilt on a build host from the same superproject 6427e9c4
# (10236/10236 targets, 0 failures, ELF machine 0xb7); the earlier 20261106151728 row
# named an artifact that existed in no store, which is why it was rebuilt.
# 2026-11-06 (later): the amd64 row is now a LOCAL build of the SAME superproject
# commit 6427e9c4, on a build host (docker 29.9.3, debian:forky amd64, native, no
# emulation): 10236/10236 targets, 0 failures, ELF machine 0x3e, acceptance gate
# build/check-payload-ships-patches.sh rc=0, version
# 20261106212410+bk0+git6427e9c4. Both rows now describe the same upstream source,
# so the earlier deliberate skew is CLOSED.
# 2026-11-09 (cycle 272): a build host desktop layer build rebuilt the payload from
# the SAME pinned sources (84 pins, native ninja 10236/10236) as version
# 20261109175812+bk0+tgzaaf1065d; its supersede logic pruned the reviewed
# 20261106212410 deb from assets/cix-debs and the vendor mirror, and the
# rebuilt payload could NOT simply replace it: the 0.3.26 screensaver plugin's
# ABI lock (post-install/lib/ncz-screensavers-plugin.lock) pins libsingularity
# sha256 for BOTH arches to the reviewed build, so a rebuilt (byte-different)
# payload breaks check-ssplugin-abi.sh at the image stage.
# 2026-11-09 (cycle 273): RECOVERY -- the reviewed deb was found intact in the
# artifact store (ncz-singularity-debs/payload-20261106222540/amd64/, sha256
# verified against this pin) and restored to assets/cix-debs; the unreviewed
# 20261109175812 rebuild is discarded. This row is reverted to the reviewed
# bytes so the payload/plugin/ABI trio matches the published payload
# (20261108-9937de3c). Keep this pin until the plugin is rebuilt against a
# new payload with a matching lock update.
# 2026-11-18 (r2d): both rows are LOCAL builds of fork superproject ef5078c (upstream singularity-desktop main 0c4f262c, 81 submodules at their latest
# heads, loginui at main) with the ported NCZ queue in assets/singularity/patches (35 patches, img/r2d-20261118): amd64 on a build host, arm64 on a build host,
# built by build/build-singularity.sh + build-singularity-deb.sh (all targets, 0 failures; shader gate OK). The debs and their sidecars are in the
# artifact store ncz-singularity-debs/payload-20261118125446/amd64 and payload-20261118125655/arm64. The screensaver plugin is rebuilt against
# these (post-install/lib/ncz-screensavers-plugin.lock).
# 2026-11-18 (later): REBUILT with the Zig system core on the baseline CPU (libsingularity zig-cpu=baseline). The first r2d payloads were built for the
# build host CPU (AVX-512 on a build host) and the shell died with an illegal instruction on Intel hosts. The rebuild is from the committed pins; libsingularity
# is byte-identical to the first build, only libsinty-system-core.so differs (0 AVX-512 instructions).
# 2026-11-18 (r2f): REBUILT with singularity-shell queue patch 0026 (IdleManager.rearm restores the screens before re-arming the idle watches; a settings change
# while the screens were dimmed or blanked left the backlight at the dim level and the display off, and the dimmed level survived reboots). Same pinned sources
# and baseline Zig CPU as the 20261118125446/20261118125655 rebuild; libsingularity is byte-identical (amd64 646fc6a6, arm64 2d236dea), so the screensaver plugin
# 0.3.27 and its lock stay valid. Built on a build host (amd64) and a build host (arm64) from cix-installer img/r2f-20261118; the debs and sidecars are in the artifact store
# ncz-singularity-debs/payload-20261118204624/amd64 and payload-20261118205017/arm64. Verified on a test machine (dim then settings change restores the backlight).
amd64
arm64
